colophon: Thus ends the hymn that brings Ganesha's protection.

lines.1: May the son of Mahesha guard my crown; may Vinayaka protect my forehead;
lines.2: may the three-eyed one protect my eyes; Shurpakarna, the fan-eared one, my ears.
lines.3: May Heramba protect my nose; may the elephant-faced one protect my mouth;
lines.4: may Ganesha protect my tongue; the beloved son of Shrikantha, my throat.
lines.5: May the mighty one protect my shoulders; may the slayer of obstacles protect my arms;
lines.6: may the bearer of the axe protect my hands; Skanda's elder brother, my heart.
lines.7: May the pot-bellied one protect my waist; the one adorned with vermilion, my navel;
lines.8: Parvati's son, my hips; may the bearer of the noose protect my haunches.
lines.9: The lord of the worlds, my knees; the one who rides the mouse, my shins;
lines.10: may the one seated on the lotus protect my feet; the breaker of the demons' pride, the ground beneath them.
lines.11: May the one-tusked protect me in front; may the lord of the ganas protect me behind;
lines.12: the lover of modakas, at my two sides; the giver of success, in all directions and between them.
lines.13: Whether I am walking or standing, waking, sleeping, or eating,
lines.14: may the god beloved of the fourth lunar day, giver of enjoyment and liberation, protect me.
lines.15: Let one recite this holy hymn with discipline on the fourth lunar day,
lines.16: worshipping the lord of obstacles, red with vermilion, with flowers and durva grass.
lines.17: King, prince, queen, minister, the whole shifting household:
lines.18: all will surely come under that person's sway, by the grace of the king of obstacles.
lines.19: Whoever writes this hymn, with its mantra and yantra, on the hand and wears it
lines.20: will have abundant wealth and grain; there is no doubt of this.
lines.22: aim klim hrim, to Vakratunda, hum.
lines.23: Chanting it six hundred thousand times with single-minded focus, after the six-limbed nyasa,
lines.24: and at the end offering into the fire, as prescribed, the eight substances, milk and ghee,
lines.25: whatever desire one holds in mind, whatever act one undertakes,
lines.26: one attains all of it, by the grace of Vakratunda.
lines.27: The person on earth who recites this hymn composed by Bhrigu
lines.28: will have unobstructed sovereignty, by the grace of Ganesha.
